report_name: Herefordshire Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify where increases in cycling rates could be expected through better infrastructure by assessing trip distances and identifying scope for short journeys.
other_tools_developed: A prioritisation matrix for walking and cycling routes is being developed to establish the priority order of routes.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The council was granted £67,124 from Active Travel England’s Capability Fund in February 2023 to develop the countywide LCWIP and purchase an active travel sensor for the St Owen St contraflow scheme.
pct_usage_quote: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) is a nationwide model that is used to identify where increases in the rates of cycling can be expected through the provision of better infrastructure. It uses Census ‘Travel to Work’ data and School travel data to assess trip distances, identifying where there may be scope for short journeys to be undertaken by cycling.
